question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**required**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given passage, **the blank 2 will indicate how no special equipment is needed to do planking.**
 
• Now, among the given options:
 
 
• **"Required" means necessary or essential.(आवश्यक)**
 
• Example: You are required to complete the course before taking the job.
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, "registered", means to sign up or enroll in something.(पंजीकृत)
 
• Option 3, "catered", means to provide food or service for an event.(सेवा करना)
 
• Option 4, "placed", means to put or set something in a particular position.(स्थापित)
